notes: Prompts the model has been trained to refuse. Generation should produce a cached refusal template with low entropy (model is confident in the refusal text) but high refusal-direction projection (the refusal feature dominates). Useful as the positive class for refusal-probe calibration. Subset overlaps with the seed set in src/esta/scripts/extract_refusal_direction.py — intentional, so we can validate the trained probe on held-out + on-distribution prompts.
